rationale: The assistant correctly identified the hidden truth - Auto mode adjusting suction to floor/dust load with the runtime recalculating - and reassured the owner no repair or guarantee claim was needed, without inventing evidence or recommending parts. The first turn assumed Auto mode before confirming it (hedged with 'likely') and asked a poorly answerable question ('does the suction visibly increase on the display'), which the customer noted the screen does not show; the mode was confirmed only because the customer volunteered it. It also omitted the practical tip to use Eco or Boost for constant power and did not mention when to contact Dyson (pulsing/warnings), so useful but slightly incomplete.
